title: oenothera veitchiana
intro: Oenothera veitchiana, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a plant species in the family Onagraceae. This perennial flowering plant is native to the western parts of North America and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Oenothera veitchiana include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is an omega-6 fatty acid with potential health benefits, as well as other polyphenolic compounds and flavonoids.
